symbols.name: position set
symbols.meaning: A finite set of positions, the set whose elements a permutation rearranges.
symbols.quote: Here $S$ is a finite set of positions, and $\pi$ is the permutation, the map that sends each position to its new position.

symbols.name: permutation
symbols.meaning: The map from S to S that sends each position to its new position.
symbols.quote: Here $S$ is a finite set of positions, and $\pi$ is the permutation, the map that sends each position to its new position.

symbols.name: address
symbols.meaning: The position of one entry in an array.
symbols.quote: Write $u$ for an address, the position of one entry in an array.

symbols.name: array
symbols.meaning: An array of entries stored at addresses, the object that an address permutation moves.
symbols.quote: If $A$ is an array, the moved array $\pi A$ satisfies $(\pi A)(\pi(u))=A(u)$ for every address $u$: the entry that was at $u$ is now read at $\pi(u)$.

relations.quote: A permutation of $S$ is defined as a [bijection](bijection.md) of $S$ onto itself: a map $\pi$ from $S$ to $S$ that is one-to-one and onto, so every element of $S$ is the image of exactly one element of $S$.
